node.label: Industry & PLI schemes
node.summary: Manufacturing policy and Production Linked Incentive schemes.

facts.text: Govt approved 12 more projects under the **Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS)**, taking total approvals to 118 and committed investment to **₹77,051 crore** (~30% above the original ₹59,350-crore target); the biggest is a ₹3,546-crore copper-foil facility by Indo Asia Copper Ltd in Amreli, Gujarat.

facts.text: Union Cabinet approved a **₹2,814-crore** capital-expenditure support scheme (5 years) for domestic **lithium and nickel** processing facilities, announced by Coal & Mines Minister **G. Kishan Reddy**.
facts.plain: Union Cabinet approved a ₹2,814-crore capital-expenditure support scheme (5 years) for domestic lithium and nickel processing facilities, announced by Coal & Mines Minister G. Kishan Reddy.

facts.text: **NMDC** iron ore output rose **18%** to 5.04 MT in October; dispatches from the **Bailadila** mines (Chhattisgarh) were hit when rain washed away parts of the **Kottavalasa-Kirandul** rail line. NMDC CMD: **Amitava Mukherjee**.

facts.text: Pune-based electric CV maker **EKA Mobility** (founder chairman **Sudhir Mehta**; Pinnacle Industries subsidiary) opened six plants in Maharashtra and M.P. (capacity **40,000** vehicles) and plans **₹1,000 crore** of R&D; order book of **11,000 e-buses** worth $1.7 bn.

facts.text: The PLI scheme for textiles was approved in **Sept 2021** with an outlay of **₹10,683 crore**; PLI schemes cover 14 sectors.
facts.plain: The PLI scheme for textiles was approved in Sept 2021 with an outlay of ₹10,683 crore; PLI schemes cover 14 sectors.

facts.text: Textiles Ministry reopens the **PLI scheme for textiles** portal (round 4) from **1 Nov to 31 Dec**, focused on **man-made fibre (MMF)** apparel, MMF fabrics and **technical textiles**.
